reminders.noDoubleTextNoDate: You wrote last. Wait for a reply.

profile.title: Chat profile
profile.topicsHelper: Type and press Enter to add.
profile.phoneInvalid: Digits only, country code first, no leading zero (7–15 digits).

quirks.title: Quirks log
quirks.empty: No quirks yet. Note how they text.

send.title: Send
send.noPhone: No phone saved: WhatsApp will ask you to pick the contact.

brief.title: AI brief
brief.intro: Copy everything your AI tool needs to help you reply. Then paste their latest messages at the end.
brief.copyError: The brief could not be copied. Check your connection and clipboard permission.
brief.aiNotesHelper: Added to "My style" when you copy the brief. Saved when you leave the field.

tpl.role: Role: you are my texting coach. Suggest 2–3 replies I could send.

settings.title: Chat settings
settings.intro: Your texting rules, timings and the base of every AI brief.
settings.aiInstructionsHelper: Used in every AI brief. Each player can add their own notes on their Chat tab.
settings.defaultInstructions: Keep it short, playful and confident. Sound like me, not like an assistant. No pickup lines, no pressure.
settings.resumeAfterHelper: When to suggest restarting a quiet chat.

openers.privacy: Sends this player’s profile, pinned notes and recent intel to Google Gemini. Nothing is stored.
openers.error: Openers could not be generated. Try again in a moment.
openers.none: No openers came back. Try again.

nudge.banner: Opened from a nudge. Check the chat state above, then get openers.

nudges.title: Nudges
nudges.intro: A notification when it is time to restart a chat. The text never shows a nickname.
nudges.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications. On iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first and open it from there.
nudges.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings, then try again.
nudges.failed: Nudges could not be changed. Try again.
